# DERMATOLOGIC SURGICAL SITE INFECTIONS

**Des Moines Guidance:**

REFER TO SYNDROME OR INFECTIOUS DISEASE FOR RECOMMENDATIONS Recommendations based on isolation of this specific pathogen are not available.
Please refer to the syndrome or infectious disease caused by this pathogen for antimicrobial therapy recommendations.

**Minneapolis Guidance:**

If an infection develops, obtain a gram stain and/or culture. Suture removal, incision and drainage is recommended. Antimicrobials may be beneficial in surgical site infections with significant systemic response (i.e induration greater than 5cm from wound edge, fever, tachycardia and leukocytosis).

In general, most post-op infections develop greater than 48 hours after surgery.

Start on antibiotics as below until culture result is available and then switch antibiotics, if indicated.

Treat for 5-7 days

# Operations involving trunk or extremity away from axilla or perineum

Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h ($) R

Penicillin allergy or MRSA risk factors
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID ($) R,DI

Severe infections or unable to take oral medications
Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h ($) R

Penicillin allergy or MRSA risk factors and severe infection or unable to take oral medications
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) R

# Operations involving the axilla, gastrointestinal tract, or perineum, or female genital tract

Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h ($) R <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q8h ($) DI

Penicillin allergy
Ciprofloxacin 50O mg PO q12h ($) R,DI <AND> metronidazole 500 mg PO q8h ($

[DI]

MRSA risk factors
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet BID ($) R,DI <AND> metronidazole

500 mg PO TID ($) [DI]

Severe infections or unable to take oral medications
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h ($) M <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h ($) DI

Penicillin allergy and severe infections or unable to take oral medications
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h ($) R,DI <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h ($

[DI]

MRSA risk factors and severe infections or unable to take oral medications < ADD > to one of the above IV regimens for operations involving axilla or perineum
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) R
